status: frozen exploratory rules; no fitted temperature predictor

nleel.interpretation: Similarity groups are exploratory, not literature-validated tolerated substitutions.

position.interpretation: The PI-requested ±50-aa display region also defines the explicit proximal search window, not a fitted biological cutoff. Prefer the earliest qualifying hit in this window; report the globally most conserved and nearest hits separately.

interface.status: user-supplied grammar; exact published grammar not independently verified
interface.interpretation: For continuity only: a = A/I/L/M/V, x = any standard residue; slashes separate three ordered windows. This interpretation and 180-aa span are inherited hypotheses, not verified Grech-Baran definitions. All segment positions are also reported independently.

classification.interpretation: Numerical thresholds frozen from v0.2.0. Proximal selection and context/structure gates are explicit corrections, not benchmark tuning. Contact counts have no calibrated TS/TT direction.

structure.interpretation: Unique residue pairs with any nonhydrogen atom distance <=4.5 A, between explicitly annotated WHD and LRR residues; excludes local sequence neighbors. A geometric descriptor, not a salt-bridge, hydrogen-bond, energetic-stability, or phenotype classifier.

references.label: Grech-Baran et al., preprint (2025), abstract verified; full classifier unavailable
Zhu et al. (2010); allele and coordinate context must be retained
Hewitt et al. (2025): distinct Sr6, Sr13 and Sr21 temperature responses
